summary.intent: Resolve automated PR review comments from Copilot and CodeRabbit on PR #392, then fix a release gate bug where test: commits could merge without E2E verification, and consolidate E2E change detection into a single orchestrator workflow.
summary.outcome: All 3 review threads on PR #392 were resolved with fixes committed. PR #394 was created and iterated on to: (1) retrigger the release gate after E2E completes on main, (2) consolidate web and desktop E2E change detection into a new ci-e2e.yml orchestrator, and (3) fix multiple follow-up review comments from Copilot and CodeRabbit across several rounds.

repo: The release gate (release-gate.yml) only enforced E2E for release-please--* branches, auto-passing with 'Not a release PR' for all other PRs — making it a rubber-stamp required check.
E2E runs on push to main, not on PRs — so the gate never blocked merges awaiting E2E results.
desktop-e2e.yml already used dorny/paths-filter for change detection; e2e.yml did not.
Committed E2E fixtures live in tests/web-e2e/fixtures/files/ and must not be overwritten/deleted by test utility functions that create temp files with matching names.
apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock does not exist — root Cargo.lock covers all Rust dependencies.
Release gate polling used --workflow=e2e.yml; after orchestrator refactor this needed updating to ci-e2e.yml.
CodeRabbit is subject to per-org rate limiting; quota resets take ~20-30 minutes between review requests.

code.finding: createTestMediaFile, createTestImageFile, createTestTextFile, createTestBinaryFile all lacked a COMMITTED_FIXTURES guard — if the caller passed a name matching a source fixture, cleanup would delete the committed file.
Missing faro_enabled: true metadata field that was specified in the plan and expected by verification.
page.evaluate() called in teardown without checking page.isClosed() first — would throw on already-closed pages.
jq // empty returns empty string on null, causing parse errors downstream; fixed to use // "" for safe fallback.
fetch-depth must be 0 for dorny/paths-filter to access the before SHA for diff; shallow clone breaks change detection.

workflow: gh run rerun on a release-please PR preserves the original GITHUB_SHA, so detect-changes diff should use origin/main rather than HEAD to get current state.
dorny/paths-filter requires fetch-depth: 0 on the checkout step to correctly compute diffs against the before commit.
Reusable workflows called via workflow_call inherit vars context from the calling repository — no need to pass vars explicitly.
Outside-diff-range review comments don't appear as unresolved GraphQL threads; must be fetched via the reviews REST endpoint instead.
Polling background tasks with sleep loops creates many orphaned background processes; a cleaner pattern would be a single longer poll.

friction: CodeRabbit rate limiting caused ~25 minutes of polling wait before its review arrived.
Background polling with repeated sleep+check bash tasks created ~20+ background processes that all needed cleanup.
Outside-diff-range CodeRabbit comments are invisible to the GraphQL reviewThreads query — required a separate REST fetch to find them.
Reply API calls timed out twice, requiring retries.
First attempt at fixing the release gate solved the wrong problem (adding E2E to feature PRs) instead of the actual issue (stale gate checks on release PRs after test: commits).
PR #393 had to be created and immediately closed after misdiagnosing the root cause.
Finding the correct REST comment IDs to reply to required multiple exploratory gh api calls.
open_items: PR #394 (ci-e2e orchestrator + release gate retrigger) still needs to be merged and verified in a real release cycle.
The retrigger-release-gate job uses gh run rerun which re-runs the last release gate run — if multiple release-please PRs exist, only the most recent run gets retriggered.
No local test run was done for the CI workflow changes — correctness depends entirely on code review and CI execution.
Desktop E2E path patterns in release-gate.yml were manually kept in sync with ci-e2e.yml; a future improvement would be a single source of truth for these paths.
The byo-ipfs register-cid 400 errors on staging (referenced in .planning/todos/pending/) remain an open investigation item.
